При движението на Луната, разстоянието на Слънцето…“).

escalations.description: The practical problem's statement (problems p.2) refers to „фиг.1“ (visible orbit of the lighter star) and „фиг.2“ (radial-velocity curve), but the archived problems PDF (2 pages) contains no drawing at all — a human should check the archive/original for a lost attachment or third page. The drawings survive only in the solutions (p.10 фиг.1 and p.12 фиг.3) with the answer overlaid; the gold leaves p5.figures empty and sets paper.caveat.

summary: Sonnet is the only candidate whose text is complete and verbatim (all five problems, all printed source typos preserved, full solutions on pp.1–12); its faults are figure boxes — one clips the rotated label of the problem-2 ellipse and two take slivers of neighbouring text — so it fails on figures only and the gold is built from it with re-measured boxes. Haiku garbles and truncates every solution and proposes text-only or half-cut crops; glm drops the k = b/a bullet, attaches the practical problem's фиг.2/фиг.3 to problem 2, crops text instead of figures twice and leaves the practical problem's solution empty. Checker glm-for-haiku was right on 12 of 14 findings (one hallucinated ellipse on the problems page, one non-defect); haiku-for-glm found two real crop defects (one at the wrong path) but missed the misattached figures and the empty solution; glm-for-sonnet was right on its two figure findings and emitted one non-defect.
